_🩺 Stability & Availability_ | _🟡 Minor_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**`GITHUB_PATH` is written only on the proxy path, and the write can break a successful install.**

`os.environ["GITHUB_PATH"]` raises `KeyError` when the variable is absent. `KeyError` is not in `(subprocess.CalledProcessError, OSError)`, so it escapes the fail-soft handler and turns the step red. This goes against the PR's fail-soft install goal. In Actions the variable is always set, so the practical risk is limited to local runs. Use `os.environ.get("GITHUB_PATH")` and skip the write when the value is empty.

<details>

```
only still-valid issues, skip the rest with a brief reason, keep changes
minimal, and validate.

In `@review.py` around lines 563 - 564, Update the GITHUB_PATH write in the venv
path setup to read the environment variable optionally and skip writing when it
is absent or empty, so local installs remain fail-soft.

After applying the fix, consider running `coderabbit review --agent` for local
review. Visit https://docs.coderabbit.ai/cli?utm_source=ghpr
```

If pip stalls, `cmd_install` can run until the job timeout because the review deadline starts only in `cmd_run`. Set timeouts for the pip and npm installation calls, and handle `subprocess.TimeoutExpired` through the existing installation-error path. Based on learnings, process-spawning calls should have a timeout and handle `TimeoutExpired`.
